product_brief: An SDK providing a complete set of cryptographic capabilities to harden security for systems and applications on major embedded platforms.
primary_platforms: STM32 Cortex M Series MCU, RA Cortex M Series MCU, PIC32 Cortex M Series MCU, STM32 Cortex M Series MPU, RL Low Power Series, SAM Cortex M Series MCU, Legacy Arm Processors, RX 32-bit, SPC5 32-bit Automotive, RZ 32/64-bit Multicore MPUs, RISC-V Processors, Stellar 32-bit Automotive, RH850 Automotive Series MCUs, AVR32
signature_schemes: NIST PQC standards, Quantropi novel digital signature (GHPPK-DS)
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Specifically optimized for IoT solutions with an efficient 64-byte ciphertext size and ~ 8K of memory utilization at NIST L5 for key exchange; 264-byte signature size and less than 11K of memory utilization at NIST L5 for digital signatures. Supports high-performance down to ultra-low-power MCUs.
financial_&_business_impact: Subscription pricing ranges from $7.5K to $40K depending on package and support level.

evidence.Signature Schemes: Quantropi’s novel digital signature (GHPPK -DS) is specifically optimized for IoT solutions with an efficient 264-byte signature size
